fields.question: What excites you most with software development?
fields.answer: What excites me most is turning real problems into products people use. I enjoy working across interfaces, APIs and integrations, then seeing those pieces come together in a useful product. At Tututor.ai / EduNova, that has meant building education workflows for teachers, students and families. I also enjoy learning tools that help me deliver a better result.
fields.source: Draft grounded in canonical product-delivery experience; no company-specific enthusiasm or new technical ability invented

fields.question: Do you think AI will replace developers?
Why?
fields.answer: AI can write better code than humans and handle repetitive work, but I don't believe it will replace software developers. It cannot replace the human understanding of business logic and people's needs, or the responsibility for deciding what to build and which system-design trade-offs to make. I see AI as a powerful tool for developers, while people remain responsible for the product and its decisions.
fields.source: Polished candidate opinion from additionalConfirmations.allcancode.aiOpinion; preserve conviction, not an evidence claim about personal system-design proficiency

fields.question: Describe a software project you are proud of
fields.answer: One project I'm proud of is Tututor.ai / EduNova, a suite of eight connected education products used by 20,000+ students, teachers and families. It brings together web and mobile workflows, including lesson-topic chatbots, AI quiz generation, automated grading and class insights. The wider platform includes real-time messaging, file storage and billing, along with three React Native apps released on both app stores.

fields.questionDescription: It can be open-source or private. It can be software built while working for a company, a personal project, or one built for an academic assignment.

fields.question: Describe your role in that project
fields.answer: I am the Lead Engineer / Full-Stack Engineer. I build and maintain the shared Express and MongoDB backend, which has approximately 1,000 API endpoints and 90 models, and deliver features across the web, mobile and AI workflows. I moved AI calls and API keys server-side. I led a small team across web and mobile delivery and now work directly with the founder on product and engineering.
